signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.description: This console and the self-service portal are one application; what you see is what this instance says you may do.

state.emptyDescription: No row matches. Create one, or widen the filter.
state.forbiddenDescription: This instance does not let you reach that. If you expected to, ask an operator to check your scope.
state.notFoundDescription: This console has no page at that address.

confirm.deleteDescription: {{name}} will be removed. This cannot be undone.
confirm.removeMemberDescription: {{name}} loses their membership of this scope, and any role that came with it.
confirm.retireDescription: {{name}} stops being usable. Its existing grants keep naming it, so session history still resolves.
confirm.revokeDescription: Session {{name}} ends immediately and its holder has to sign in again.
confirm.revokeGrantDescription: {{name}} loses its access immediately, including any refresh token it still holds.
confirm.rotateDescription: {{name}} gets a new secret and the old one stops working at once. Anything using it has to be updated.

help.codexPlanType: A client-facing wire label for this gateway plan, not a purchased upstream entitlement.
help.expiresAtMs: Leave empty for a key that never expires.
help.id: The client_id the third-party binary was built with. It cannot be generated here, and cannot be changed afterwards.
help.limitValue: A decimal amount, as text: a limit has to survive a JavaScript number unchanged.
help.metric: requests, concurrency, or any counter name the host charges.
help.modelPattern: A glob over the model name: * and ?, anchored. * also matches a request that names no model.
help.oauthClientAllowlist: One client id per line. Empty inherits the level above; a list of none denies every client.
help.organizationId: The binding that decides the budget chain, the permission subject and which credentials this key may reach — all at once, and only here.
help.password: Optional. An account created without one cannot sign in until a password is set, which is what an API-key-only account is.
help.periodSeconds: Required and positive for a fixed period; unused otherwise.
help.planId: The plan's limits are copied at issuance: re-pointing an issued subscription does not resize existing windows.
help.priority: Higher wins. A deny beats an allow at the same priority.
help.redirectUris: One per line. A redirect is matched exactly, never by prefix.
help.retainSecret: Keep a sealed copy so the key can be revealed later. Off by default: a key the instance cannot reproduce is a key a database leak does not hand over.
help.sourceKey: The canonical issuer plus upstream subscription identity. It is what deduplicates one real subscription imported under several credentials.
help.startsAtMs: The anchor fixed-duration allowances are measured from. Empty anchors at the moment it is issued.
help.userId: A rule names a user or a key, never both.
